#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct IntList {
    std::vector<int> data;
    int size = 0;

    IntList() {
        data.resize(3);
        size = 0;
    }

    bool isEmpty() {
        return size == 0;
    }

    int size() {
        return size;
    }

    int get(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) {
            throw std::out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        }
        return data[index];
    }

    void clear() {
        size = 0;
    }

    void set(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) {
            throw std::out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        }
        data[index] = value;
    }

    void expand() {
        if (size >= (int)data.size()) {
            data.resize((data.size() << 1) + 1);
        }
    }

    void insert(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index > size) {
            throw std::out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        }
        expand();
        data.insert(data.begin() + index, value);
        size++;
    }

    int delete_at(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) {
            throw std::out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        }
        int value = data[index];
        data.erase(data.begin() + index);
        size--;
        return value;
    }

    void push(int value) {
        expand();
        if ((int)data.size() <= size) {
            data.resize(size + 1);
        }
        data[size++] = value;
    }

    int pop() {
        if (size == 0) {
            throw std::out_of_range("Pop from empty");
        }
        return data[--size];
    }

    void unshift(int value) {
        expand();
        data.insert(data.begin(), value);
        size++;
    }

    int shift() {
        if (size == 0) {
            throw std::out_of_range("Shift from empty");
        }
        int value = data[0];
        data.erase(data.begin());
        size--;
        return value;
    }
};

struct IntIntMap {
    static const int EMPTY = INT_MIN;
    std::vector<int> data;
    int size = 0;

    IntIntMap() {
        data.resize(4);
        for (int i = 0; i < data.size(); i += 2) {
            data[i] = EMPTY;
        }
        size = 0;
    }

    bool isEmpty() {
        return size == 0;
    }

    int size() {
        return size;
    }

    void clear() {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)data.size(); i += 2) {
            data[i] = EMPTY;
        }
        size = 0;
    }

    static int hash(int key) {
        long long hash_val = (long long)key * 1000000007LL;
        hash_val ^= (hash_val >> 16);
        hash_val ^= (hash_val >> 24);
        return (int)hash_val;
    }

    bool have(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Key cannot be EMPTY");
        }
        int mask = (int)data.size() - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                return true;
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    int get(int key, int default_) {
        if (key == EMPTY) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Key cannot be EMPTY");
        }
        int mask = (int)data.size() - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                return data[i + 1];
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                return default_;
            }
        }
    }

    static std::vector<int> resize(const std::vector<int>& oldData, int newCapacity) {
        std::vector<int> ndata(newCapacity);
        for (int i = 0; i < newCapacity; i += 2) {
            ndata[i] = EMPTY;
        }
        int oldCapacity = (int)oldData.size();
        int mask = newCapacity - 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < oldCapacity; i += 2) {
            int cur = oldData[i];
            if (cur == EMPTY) continue;
            for (int j = hash(cur) & mask;; j = (j - 1) & mask) {
                if (ndata[j] == EMPTY) {
                    ndata[j] = cur;
                    ndata[j + 1] = oldData[i + 1];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return ndata;
    }

    void set(int key, int value) {
        if (key == EMPTY) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Key cannot be EMPTY");
        }
        int capacity = (int)data.size();
        int mask = capacity - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                data[i + 1] = value;
                return;
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                data[i] = key;
                data[i + 1] = value;
                if (++size > capacity >> 2) {
                    data = resize(data, capacity << 1);
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void delete_at(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Key cannot be EMPTY");
        }
        int capacity = (int)data.size();
        int mask = capacity - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                int j = i;
                while (true) {
                    int k;
                    for (k = (j - 1) & mask; data[k] == EMPTY; k = (k - 1) & mask);
                    int k_hash = hash(data[k]);
                    if ((k_hash >= i) ^ (k_hash < j) ^ (i < j))
                        break;
                    data[j] = data[k];
                    data[j + 1] = data[k + 1];
                    j = k;
                }
                data[j] = EMPTY;
                --size;
                return;
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void expand(int newCapacity) {
        if ((int)data.size() >> 2 < newCapacity) {
            data = resize(data, std::max((int)std::bit_ceil(newCapacity - 1) << 3, 4));
        }
    }

    void shrink() {
        int oldCapacity = (int)data.size();
        if (oldCapacity > 4 && (oldCapacity >> 3) >= size) {
            int newCap = std::max((int)std::bit_ceil(size - 1) << 3, 4);
            data = resize(data, newCap);
        }
    }
};

static std::vector<IntList> freeLists;

static IntList takeList() {
    if (freeLists.empty()) {
        return IntList();
    } else {
        IntList res = std::move(freeLists.back());
        freeLists.pop_back();
        return res;
    }
}

static void putList(IntList& list) {
    list.clear();
    freeLists.push_back(std::move(list));
}

static int n, m;

static IntList solve(int from, int to) {
    IntList res;
    if (from + 1 == to) {
        res = takeList();
        res.push(from);
        if (from + m > n) {
            res.push(n - from);
            res.push(from - n);
        }
        res.push(m);
        if (from > m) {
            res.push(n - from);
            res.push(from);
        }
        res.push(-from);
        return res;
    } else {
        int mid = (from + to) >> 1;
        IntList a = solve(from, mid);
        IntList b = solve(mid, to);
        res = takeList();
        int aSize = a.size, bSize = b.size;
        int* aData = a.data.data();
        int* bData = b.data.data();
        for (int i = 0;; i += 2) {
            int bFrom = (i == 0) ? 0 : bData[i - 1];
            int bTo = (i == bSize - 1) ? n : bData[i + 1];
            int bShift = bData[i];
            int aFrom = bFrom + bShift;
            int aTo = bTo + bShift;
            int l = 0, r = aSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (aData[m] <= aFrom) {
                    l = m + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m - 1;
                }
            }
            int cur = l;
            while (true) {
                res.push(bShift + aData[cur]);
                ++cur;
                if (cur == aSize) break;
                int pos = aData[cur];
                if (pos >= aTo) break;
                res.push(pos - bShift);
                ++cur;
            }
            if (i == bSize - 1) break;
            res.push(bTo);
        }
        putList(a);
        putList(b);
        return res;
    }
}

static void solve() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int s;
    long long t;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cin >> s; s--;
    cin >> t;
    long long cycles = t / n;

    // Adjust s based on the initial t
    long long rem = t % n;

    for (long long ct = rem; ct != 0; ct--) {
        if (s < m) {
            s += 1; // will be adjusted within the loop
            s += ct;
            if (s >= n)
                s -= n;
        } else {
            s -= 1;
            s -= ct;
            if (s < 0)
                s += n;
        }
    }

    if (cycles > 0) {
        IntList cycleSolve = solve(0, n);
        int csSize = cycleSolve.size, *csData = cycleSolve.data.data();
        IntList cycleList = takeList();
        IntIntMap cycleMap;
        for (int i = 0;; i++) {
            if (i == cycles) break;
            int prev = cycleMap.get(s, -1);
            if (prev >= 0) {
                int idx = prev + (int)((cycles - prev) % (i - prev));
                s = cycleList.get(idx);
                break;
            }
            cycleList.push(s);
            cycleMap.set(s, i);
            int l = 0, r = csSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (csData[m] <= s) {
                    l = m + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m - 1;
                }
            }
            s += csData[l];
        }
        putList(cycleList);
    }

    cout << s + 1 << "\n";
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
